channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Brandon Knight | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Brandon Knight from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Tyson Chandler on Eric Bledsoe, Brandon Knight, Devin Booker
item.description:
“He was like, ‘Really? What do you think about (Knight and Bledsoe)?' I was like, ‘They’re good, but I’m telling you, me, them, this roster, (Booker is) better than all of us. That’s the best player you got on this roster,’ and he was like ‘Really?’”

Tyson Chandler on Eric Bledsoe, Brandon Knight, Devin Booker, Sep 8, 2023. Source: Arizona Republic.

item.title: Mike D'Antoni on Brandon Knight
item.description:
Salman Ali:Mike D'Antoni on Brandon Knight's debut:

“He's rusty and you know that, but the ease at which he can get shots... He got two (shots) up there that he'll make... I'm encouraged and I think that he can help us.”

Mike D'Antoni on Brandon Knight, Dec 14, 2018. Source: Twitter @RedNationHoops.

item.title: Mike D'Antoni on Brandon Knight
item.description:
Salman Ali:Mike D'Antoni on Brandon Knight's eventual return:

“If we can get him back to where he was before his injury, we're talking about one of the better players in the league.”

Mike D'Antoni on Brandon Knight, Dec 1, 2018. Source: Twitter @RedNationHoops.

item.title: Mike D'Antoni on Brandon Knight
item.description:
Mike D'Antoni on the status of Brandon Knight and Nene:

“Obviously it's another week closer than the last time we talked, but they're not ready yet.”

Mike D'Antoni on Brandon Knight, Nov 20, 2018. Source: Twitter @RedNationHoops.

item.title: Earl Watson on Brandon Knight
item.description:
Watson on Knight being a sixth man:

“He's a starter in this league. He's sacrificed the most for this team. He took it like the pro he is.”

Earl Watson on Brandon Knight, Oct 4, 2016. Source: Twitter @paulcoro.

item.title: Eric Bledsoe on Brandon Knight
item.description:
Paul Coro:Eric Bledsoe on playing with Brandon Knight:

“Right now, I'm through the roof, especially with playing pickup (in recent weeks).”

Eric Bledsoe on Brandon Knight, Sep 28, 2015. Source: Twitter @paulcoro.

item.title: Lon Babby on Brandon Knight
item.description:
Paul Coro:Suns president Lon Babby:

“Nothing that we have done (this summer) is more important than re-signing Brandon Knight.”

Lon Babby on Brandon Knight, Jul 20, 2015. Source: Twitter @paulcoro.

item.title: Ryan McDonough on Brandon Knight
item.description:
Paul Coro:McDonough on Knight being a RFA:

“We all learned from Eric’s (Bledsoe) situation last year. I think & hope this one will go a lot smoother.”

Ryan McDonough on Brandon Knight, Apr 15, 2015. Source: Twitter @paulcoro.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Brandon Knight
item.description:
“I look at Brandon, he goes at the speed that I think I went at when I was 19 or 20 years old,”

Jason Kidd on Brandon Knight, Oct 26, 2014. Source: Milwaukee Journal-Sentinel.

item.title: Rodney Stuckey on Brandon Knight
item.description:
Stuckey said about his poor shooting.

“I just feel like last year, I was having the ball in my hand, being able to create, and play in transition. Coming in the second quarter when Brandon Knight went to the bench last year, being the point guard, and being able to use my post position on smaller guards, I just feel like I'm not using that right now.”

Rodney Stuckey on Brandon Knight, Nov 6, 2012. Source: TalkBasket.

item.title: Tayshaun Prince on Brandon Knight
item.description:
“Brandon Knight is our starting point guard and will continue to be, but hopefully we can get a veteran point guard to kind of mentor him a little bit,”

Tayshaun Prince on Brandon Knight, Apr 29, 2012. Source: Detroit Free Press.

item.title: John Calipari on Brandon Knight
item.description:
John Calipari said he knew Miami native Brandon Knight needed to test his talents in the 2011 NBA draft.

“I told Brandon, when I knew he was No. 3 through 8, I hugged him and said “I loved coaching ya, I wanna keep coaching you, but you need to do this,”

John Calipari on Brandon Knight, May 21, 2011. Source: Orlando Sentinel.
